Check · the rule

The -S rule! 💙

it / he / she + one thing → the verb takes -S!

🎯 He… — say the form, then tap!
like likes go goes watch watches have has do does play plays

💡 Routines and facts → Present Simple — today you will use it!

Check · SB p. 91 ex. 6

Your questions! ❓

🎯 Read your question + short answer — then tap and check!
1Jason / want / a rabbit → Does Jason want a rabbit? — No, he doesn't. ✏️ (the printed example)
2their parents / want / an iguana? — Do their parents want an iguana? No, they don't.
3they all / watch TV? — Do they all watch TV? Yes, they do.
4What / Jackie / do / at the weekend? — What does Jackie do at the weekend? She hangs out with her best friend.
5Where / Jason / go / at the weekend? — Where does Jason go at the weekend? He goes to the park with his friends.

🐻 Peter 5.

💙 it / he / she → the verb takes -S: plays · goes · does

Think about it! 🧩

The detective question 🕵️

🏒 Peter plays hockey. Hockey is a winter sport.

🥋 Taekwondo is NOT a winter sport.

🎯 Which sport does Peter do in summer?
Taekwondo! 🥋 Hockey is for winter — so taekwondo is for summer!

Extra activity · the mime game 🎭

Guess my sport! 🤸

1. Play in groups of four.

2. One player chooses a person from the photos on page 94 — copy their pose!

3. The others guess the sport. First to guess — 1 point! ⭐

4. The winner shows the next pose.

5. Play until all the photos are used! 🏁
